See ``docs/spec.md`` for the authoritative module contract.

from __future__ import annotations

__all__ = ["page_count", "slice_page", "iter_pages"]


def _check_size(size: object) -> None:
    """Raise ``ValueError`` unless ``size`` is an ``int`` >= 1 (not a bool)."""
    if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"size must be an int >= 1, got {size!r}")


def _check_page(page: object) -> None:
    """Raise ``ValueError`` unless ``page`` is an ``int`` >= 0 (not a bool)."""
    if isinstance(page, bool) or not isinstance(page, int) or page < 0:
        raise ValueError(f"page must be an int >= 0, got {page!r}")


def _check_items(items: object) -> None:
    """Raise ``TypeError`` unless ``items`` is a ``list``."""
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        raise TypeError(f"items must be a list, got {type(items).__name__}")


def page_count(total: int, size: int) -> int:
    """Number of pages needed to hold ``total`` items at ``size`` per page.

    ``total`` must be an ``int`` >= 0 (not a bool) and ``size`` an ``int`` >= 1
    (not a bool), otherwise ``ValueError`` is raised.

    Returns ``ceil(total / size)``; as a documented legacy rule, an empty
    collection still counts as exactly one (empty) page, so
    ``page_count(0, size) == 1``.
    """
    if isinstance(total, bool) or not isinstance(total, int) or total < 0:
        raise ValueError(f"total must be an int >= 0, got {total!r}")
    _check_size(size)
    if total == 0:
        return 1
    return -(-total // size)


def slice_page(items: list, page: int, size: int) -> list:
    """Return the 0-based ``page``-th slice of ``items``.

    ``items`` must be a ``list`` (else ``TypeError``); ``page`` an ``int``
    >= 0 (not a bool); ``size`` an ``int`` >= 1 (not a bool), else
    ``ValueError``.

    Page ``p`` is ``items[p*size:(p+1)*size]``. The final page may be
    partial, and a page beyond the end returns ``[]`` (not an error).
    """
    _check_items(items)
    _check_page(page)
    _check_size(size)
    return items[page * size:(page + 1) * size]


def iter_pages(items: list, size: int) -> list:
    """Return all pages of ``items`` in order.

    ``items`` must be a ``list`` (else ``TypeError``); ``size`` an ``int``
    >= 1 (not a bool), else ``ValueError``.

    The result contains exactly ``page_count(len(items), size)`` pages, each
    a list. For empty ``items`` that is ``[[]]`` — one empty page, per the
    same legacy rule as ``page_count``.
    """
    _check_items(items)
    _check_size(size)
    return [
        slice_page(items, page, size)
        for page in range(page_count(len(items), size))
    ]
